name: What are the benefits of building an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an attached ADU offers several benefits, including increased property value, potential rental income, and flexible space for family members, guests, or a home office. Since they are attached, they can sometimes be more cost-effective to build than detached units due to shared infrastructure and utilities. They can also offer easier access for caregivers or multi-generational living, maintaining a close connection to the primary residence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attached ADUs increase property value, provide rental income potential, and offer flexible living space for families or guests.
